metadata.name: 心智娘 · 温柔共生（发饰版 v2）
metadata.tips: She pins the last ornament in place before asking whether you will notice. Tiny fungal flowers now nest in her pale hair. Colony communications are working perfectly, except for the line that carries your compliments. That one occasionally overheats.
